title: Cao et al. (2017) supplement: palaeogeography since the late Palaeozoic revised with palaeobiology
citation: Cao, W., Zahirovic, S., Flament, N., Williams, S., Golonka, J., and Müller, R. D., 2017. Improving global paleogeography since the late Paleozoic using paleobiology. Biogeosciences, 14, 5425-5439. doi:10.5194/bg-14-5425-2017

contents: Golonka et al. (2006) palaeogeography digitised into ice sheet, mountain, landmass and shallow-marine shapefiles at present-day coordinates for 24 intervals, 402-2 Ma, with its rotations; the same revised against Paleobiology Database marine fossils and attached to the Matthews et al. (2016) plate model; 24 reconstructed GeoTIFFs (6001 x 3001, WGS84); the consistent and inconsistent marine fossil collections used in the test.
evidence: An independent lineage from PALEOMAP: Golonka's maps, tested and revised against marine fossil collections downloaded from the Paleobiology Database on 2016-09-07.
status: Collected for review; not used by the viewer.
